title: justicia tinctoriella
intro: Justicia tinctoriella, commonly known as "Chandrasura" or "Shrimp plant," is a plant species belonging to the family Acanthaceae. This plant is known for its traditional uses in Ayurvedic medicine, where it is valued for its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Justicia tinctoriella include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and combat infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
